title: Polynomial affine resolution from stalkwise finite Tor dimension
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a locally finite type morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $Y$ Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and stalkwise finite Tor dimension [def-pc-perfect-morphism]. For affine opens $U\subset Y$, $V\subset X$ with $V\subset f^{-1}U$, put $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$ and $B=\Gamma(X,V)$. Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $g:A[t_1,\ldots,t_n]\to B$ be a surjective ring homomorphism whose restriction to $A$ is the coordinate map induced by $f$. Then there exist $d\in\mathbb N$ and a projective resolution $P_\bullet\to B$ of $B$ as an $A[t_1,\ldots,t_n]$-module [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension] such that $P_i=0$ for all $i>d$. The polynomial presentation and bound may have $n=0$, $d=0$, and $B=0$.

proof.text: Set R = Γ(Y,U)[t₁,...,tₙ] and M equal to Γ(X,V) with scalar restriction through g. The affine sections are Noetherian by IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian; R is Noetherian by the polynomial instance. The semilinear map defined by g induces a surjective R-linear map R → M using ModuleCat.semilinearMapAddEquiv, so Module.Finite.of_surjective proves finiteness. Apply the pointwise affine-polynomial theorem to obtain finite projective dimension at each prime.

The loci O_n where the localized projective dimension is at most n are open by the proved locus theorem, and cover the prime spectrum by the pointwise result. Compactness gives a finite subcover s. Put d = s.sup id, which is also defined for the empty spectrum and empty subcover. At every prime choose a subcover index n and use n ≤ d and hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge to obtain the bound d. Mathlib ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff_forall_primeSpectrum gives HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d globally. This is the explicit proof of the local-to-global step; no bounded perfect representative is postulated.

Apply the explicit resolution/dimension bridge directly to HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d with both universe arguments u. Unpack the resulting actual ProjectiveResolution P and its zero-term bound. Return d, P and that bound unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem affinePolynomial_boundedResolution_of_stalkwise
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hperfect : HasStalkwiseFiniteTorDimension f)
    (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (n : ℕ) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(Y, U) →+* Γ(X, V))
    (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (hcomp : g.comp (MvPolynomial.C) = (f.appLE U V e).hom) :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (P : ProjectiveResolution
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars g).obj (ModuleCat.of Γ(X, V) Γ(X, V)))),
      ∀ i : ℕ, d < i → IsZero (P.complex.X i)
